wholePhysicalScope: The named former site is bounded by Christchurch City Council heritage item 425, Schedule 738, Heritage New Zealand listing 7353. Its original recorded geometry and surviving path controls anchor an estimated late-operating footprint using 1873–78 construction and yard records.
lodDetails: Four detail levels keep the Gothic gateway and houses, open terraces and stairs, multi-storey concrete ranges, roof breaks and enclosing walls. Closer views refine openings, copings and balconies.
limitations: The Christchurch City Council boundary and surviving steps establish the site. The vanished building outlines, yard placements and later internal layout are estimated.

The 1878 gaoler’s yard dimensions are retained. The 1873 and 1875 records distinguish two-storey and three-storey construction. The model uses the published facts to approximate the operating complex around 1903.
Roof pitches, windows, the appearance of the gate, materials’ color and details are estimates. The reconstruction uses written evidence and mapped controls without adopting archival imagery.
The original elevation samples remain unchanged. Terraces and foundations use approximate grade registration on the steep site.
